summary: A posted journal entry is permanent (Ed 2026-10-09). Creates journal_entry_corrections, the append-only record linking each correction of a posted entry by an application workflow (AP invoice re-code, line re-code, prior-period hold) to its invoice, original entry, the entry actually reversed, the correcting (reversal) entry, the replacement, the actor, the time and the reason. Scar: LOPF JE-2026-00169..00172 lost their lines on 2026-09-28. Repairs nothing; no existing row changes; adds no trigger to journal_entries or journal_entry_lines (independent of 502).

preflight.name: journal_entry_corrections does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'journal_entry_corrections'

preflight.name: journal_entries and ap_invoices exist
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('journal_entries','ap_invoices')

expected_changes: Creates table journal_entry_corrections: community, invoice (nullable), original entry, corrected entry, correcting entry (nullable), replacement entry (nullable), kind IN ap_recode / ap_line_recode / ap_hold_prior_periods, actor id (nullable) + actor name, reason, created_at. Every FK ON DELETE RESTRICT. A row names a correcting entry or a replacement; reason and actor name are non-blank. One row per correcting entry (partial unique index).
A guard trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE (append-only).
Grants SELECT, INSERT to service_role and SELECT to authenticated.
No existing row in any table is changed; no trigger is added to journal_entries or journal_entry_lines.

verify.name: the table exists and is empty
